# dsh-session-overview
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness community plugin: one **recent sessions** list across **all workspaces**, with a
color-coded badge showing which workspace each session belongs to.
## Why
The built-in sidebar groups sessions under their workspaces, so finding "that session from the other
project" means clicking through every workspace. This plugin gives you a single recency-sorted view
of every session, with the workspace always visible.
## Features
- **Sidebar section** — an expandable "Recent sessions" block above the sidebar foot showing the 10

most recent sessions; collapse state persists.
- **Full panel** — a "All sessions" icon in the sideb
ar rail opens a complete view: search by session title or workspace name, show-more paging, one-clic

k filtering by workspace badge.
- **Workspace color badges** — a deterministic 10-hue palette hashed

from each workspace folder path; the same workspace always carries the same color, everywhere.
- **
Selection highlight** — the session currently open in the main area is highlighted in the list, live

.
- **Running spinner** — running sessions show an animated open-ring marker instead of a static dot

.
- **Right-click menu** — the same verbs as the built-in session rows: pin/unpin, rename, fork, cop
y title / session id, archive/unarchive. All operations go through the same host channels, so state
stays in sync with the native sidebar.

ugin manager, or add it to your profile's bundle stack manually.
Requires the standard web client composition (sidebar + workspace browser + layout).
## How it works
The client half registers three slot entries:
| Slot | Entry |

| `sidebar.panellist` + `main` (key `session-overview`) | the full overview panel |
| `sidebar.foote

r.action` | the collapsible sidebar section |
| — | context menu overlay lives inside each list comp

| — | context menu overlay lives inside each list component |
Data comes from the same client stores the native sidebar uses (`sessions.list`, `workspaces.list`),
so lists update live without polling. No Host-side logic beyond an empty plugin body.
## Compatibility
Developed against DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 (desktop, macOS). Slot contracts used: `sidebar.panell
ist`, `main`, `sidebar.footer.action`; client services: `sessions`, `workspaces`, `uiWorkspace`, `la
idebar.footer.action`; client services: `sessions`, `workspaces`, `uiWorkspace`, `layout`, `locale`.
